verdict.rationale: Neon's own SQL Editor has built-in AI features that help write and optimize SQL queries. Those suggestions are grounded in the schema only, since Neon states 'no actual data is shared', so the product does not generate insights from the user's data. The `neon ask` assistant answers only from documentation, and MCP data inspection happens in external agents rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: in-product AI insights derived from actual data contents, documented insight/suggestion surfaces beyond query-writing help, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Neon SQL Editor includes AI-powered features to assist with writing, optimizing, and generating names for SQL queries.
we share your database schema with the AI agent, but no actual data is shared
